verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI code-review automation product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents event-driven review triggers on pull requests, on-demand CLI runs, and one-off agent loops such as greplooping. Running `greptile review` in CI relies on the host CI platform's scheduler, which is a user-side workaround and not a Greptile capability, so nothing shows a native recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
